mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_agent_mcp WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.server_name AS serverName, m.url AS url, m.enabled AS enabled, m.connect_status AS connectStatus, m.create_time AS createTime, m.update_time AS updateTime FROM user_agent_mcp b JOIN user_mcp_server m ON m.id = b.mcp_server_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.agent_id = #{agentId} AND m.enabled = 1 ORDER BY b.id DESC
